text.copy1:
Fairywren
An exhibition in four screens
text.shot1: The camera enters a top-lit gallery as light falls from the clerestory.
text.shot2: A glide to the first framed screen, focus pulling from the frame to its wall label.
text.shot3: On to the second piece without a cut, a bench passing in the foreground.
text.shot4: The third piece under its own spotlight; the label sharpens as the frame softens.
text.shot5: The last piece, a browser window, hung a little higher for the punchline.
text.shot6: The exit opens onto the lockup and the glide slows to a hold.
